# Eirvan Foods® - Full Knowledge Base & Product Directory

> Comprehensive product specifications, nutritional profiles, sourcing provenance, and ordering information for Eirvan Foods® (Natural Goodness • Better Tomorrow), Pakistan.

## Brand Identity & Mission
Eirvan Foods® is an artisanal Pakistani brand dedicated to delivering pure, unadulterated dry fruits, cold stone-ground superfood powders, and bespoke gifting collections. Our mission: "Natural Goodness • Better Tomorrow". We bypass mass-market wholesale bleaching and chemical fumigation, sourcing directly from generational orchardists in Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan, Balochistan, and Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah.

## Complete Product Catalog

### 1. Kashmiri Mamra Almonds (مامرا بادام)
- Origin: Kashmir Valley, Himalayas
- Profile: Concave, grooved shape; rich amber-brown natural skin. High natural almond oil content (>52%).
- Sizes: 250g (PKR 2,450), 500g (PKR 4,800), 1kg (PKR 9,200).
- Health Benefits: Rich in monounsaturated fats, Vitamin E, magnesium, and dietary fibre. Renowned in traditional Unani medicine for cognitive memory and student focus.

### 2. Gilgit Soft-Shell Kagzi Walnuts (کاغذی اخروٹ)
- Origin: Hunza & Gilgit-Baltistan
- Profile: Paper-thin shell easily cracked by hand; intact creamy butterfly halves; high in ALA plant-based Omega-3 fatty acids.
- Sizes: 500g (PKR 1,850), 1kg (PKR 3,500).
- Health Benefits: Cardiovascular endothelial support, neuroprotective antioxidants, and gut microbiome balance.

### 3. Royal Shahi Panjiri & Superfood Powders (شاہی پنجیری)
- Composition: Stone-ground Mamra almonds, kagzi walnuts, char magaz (melon seeds), gond katira, makhana (foxnuts), desi ghee, and pure cardamom.
- Uses: Daily nutritional supplement stirred into warm milk or taken with morning tea. Ideal for postnatal maternal recovery, winter nourishment, and elderly strength.
- Sizes: 200g jar (PKR 1,450), 500g tin (PKR 3,200).

### 4. Authentic Madinah Ajwa Dates (عجوہ کھجور)
- Origin: Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah, Saudi Arabia
- Profile: Soft, dark prune-colored fruit with fine white grain lines; subtle fruity caramel sweetness without cloying syrupiness.
- Sizes: 250g (PKR 1,950), 500g (PKR 3,800), 1kg (PKR 7,200).
- Health Benefits: High polyphenol antioxidant concentration; scientifically studied for cardiac health and blood pressure regulation.

### 5. Kandahari Sundarkhani Golden Raisins (سندرخانی کشمش)
- Origin: Kandahar & Quetta Orchards
- Profile: Elongated, slender golden silhouettes cured naturally under ambient mountain sunlight without sulphur burning.
- Sizes: 250g (PKR 750), 500g (PKR 1,400), 1kg (PKR 2,600).

### 6. Artisan Keepsake Gift Collections
- Varieties: Deep Olive Linen Hampers and Handcrafted Chiniot Pinewood Chests.
- Features: 4 to 6 airtight glass jars, customizable satin ribbons, and hand-lettered calligraphy recipient notes.
- Pricing: Starting at PKR 4,500 up to PKR 18,500. Corporate and bulk customization available.

## Order Fulfillment & Pakistan Logistics
- Deliveries: Nationwide across Pakistan including Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta, Multan, Faisalabad, Sialkot, Gujranwala, Hyderabad, and all tehsils.
- Lead Times: 24–48 hours for Lahore & twin cities; 2–4 business days nationwide via TCS & Leopard Express.
- Payment Options: Cash on Delivery (COD), State Bank Raast (03176369458), and Direct Bank Transfer.
- Free Shipping Threshold: Free delivery for all orders exceeding PKR 3,500.
